title: Delta and omicron flight configurations of the craft

tellings.quote: When all three of the amplifiers are being used for travel, they're in the delta configuration. And when only one is being used for travel, it's in the omicron configuration.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says that in the late 1980s he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada desert site called S4, told the podcast host Jesse Michels how one craft flew. Lazar says it had three amplifiers, parts that drove its movement: when all three were used for travel it was in what he calls the delta configuration, and when only one was used it was in the omicron configuration. If true, it would be a first-hand description of how a non-human vehicle works.
